keyphrases: Netherlands team members claim home internet costs
candidate.user_input: How do Netherlands team members claim home internet costs and what should they do if their address or the amount changes?
candidate.reference: Netherlands team members must fill in and sign the Regeling Internet Thuis form and send it to the HRSavvy team at payroll@savvy-group.eu. If their address or the amount changes, they should send a new form to the HRSavvy team along with the invoice/letter for processing.

evidence.quote: If you have not already completed the form as part of onboarding with our Netherlands payroll provider, fill in and sign the [Regeling Internet Thuis] form and send it to the HRSavvy team at payroll@savvy-group.eu. evidence.contribution: This explains the process for claiming home internet costs and what to do if there are changes.
